blockingIssues.description: Correctness gate result is computed in harness flows but not used to fail smoke/run command exit status. A failing correctness gate can still return success, so VAL-BENCH-004 is not hard-enforced end-to-end.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require explicit fail-state propagation tests for correctness-gate failures (smoke/run CLI must exit non-zero when correctness gate fails), not just gate artifact generation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of benchmark-harness-manifests-correctness-env found correctness-gate status recorded but not propagated to harness smoke/run failure status.
